data.title: Telling Time — Beginner · Lesson 4
data.subject: time
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Soft rain sounds)

[Hook]
Rain is falling… La lluvia cae
Time to learn… Hora de aprender
Morning's here… La mañana está aquí
Let's begin… Empecemos

[Verse]
Early morning… Mañana temprano
Coffee in my hand, feeling so grand.
At noon… Al mediodía
The sun peeks through, skies so blue.
In the afternoon… Por la tarde
I watch the clouds, feeling so free.
Dusk arrives… Anochecer
The day goes by, oh so fast.

[Hook]
Rain is falling… La lluvia cae
Time to learn… Hora de aprender
Morning's here… La mañana está aquí
Let's begin… Empecemos

[Verse]
Half an hour… Media hora
Passes by, time flies like a bird.
Quarter of an hour… Un cuarto de hora
Tick-tock goes the clock, can't you hear?
Before the hour… Antes de la hora
I set my watch, never be late.
After the hour… Después de la hora
Time moves on, it's never fake.

[Bridge]
La hora, el minuto
Tick-tock, tick-tock, can't you see?
In this rainy day, cozy and free.
Learning Spanish, just you and me.

[Hook]
